items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: And we played a battle of music against Chick Webb up at some club on 145th Street

ctx.x: Snowden's band, yeah. And we played a battle of music against Chick Webb up at some club on 145th Street, I forget the name of it now, and we played "Chinatown" there, and that wiped everybody out. Because all the vipers was there, you know. And I was in pretty good company from then on, you know.
Then, after that thing folded... Then I went back with Charlie Johnson.
